mechanism: St. John's Wort may induce CYP3A4 and other metabolic pathways, potentially affecting infliximab metabolism and efficacy; additionally, St. John's Wort has immunomodulatory properties that may interfere with TNF-alpha inhibition.
action: Monitor for reduced infliximab efficacy; counsel patients to avoid St. John's Wort or obtain gastroenterologist/rheumatologist approval before concurrent use; consider alternative antidepressants with minimal drug interactions.
